about: Curated picks for Reelwright's tasks. Sizes and shapes are hand-entered from the model cards (shown as estimated until the model is installed and Ollama reports its own). A pick becomes selectable once installed: selections are pinned to the installed digest.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.why: Strong JSON-following clip finder that leaves VRAM for OBS on a 24 GiB card.

models.name: Qwen3 14B
models.why: Better judgment on long streams; still fits beside a game at 8K context.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.why: Fast titles and captions; long context for whole-transcript metadata.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B
models.why: Reads frames as well as text: the visual judge and video-type pass.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL 7B
models.why: Small vision model for frame checks (accepts images; does not generate them).

models.name: nomic-embed-text v1.5
models.why: Embeddings for clip search and de-duplication.

models.name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
models.why: Reelwright's default transcriber: near large-v3 accuracy at several times the speed (faster-whisper, not Ollama).

models.name: Whisper large-v3
models.why: Best accuracy for hard audio and rare languages; slower.

models.name: Whisper small
models.why: CPU-only PCs: usable speed without a GPU.
